name: Fairfield County, OH
findings: Fairfield County has 503 nonprofit organizations. 228 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 189 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fairfield County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 14 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
